# JetFighter Agent Schema Reference

Schema version: `1.1.0`

Every request/response is one JSON object validated against `schema/agent.schema.json`. `additionalProperties: false` is set on every object in this schema, so any unknown field is a hard rejection, not a warning.

## Top-level shape

| section | required | purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | session/versioning envelope |
| `intent` | yes | what action, on what domain, at what priority |
| `payload` | yes | the action-specific data |
| `response` | no (server-filled) | filled in by `gateway/gateway.py`, itself schema-validated before being returned |

## Enforcement guarantees encoded in this schema

- `FileOp.op` enum: `['write', 'append', 'delete', 'stat']` — notice there is no `read`. There is no schema-valid way to ask this gateway for raw file content.
- `RetrievedChunk.content` has `maxLength: 2000`.
- `CommandExec.capped` is `const: true` — a request that sets it to `false` fails validation before anything runs.
- `LogOp.tail_lines` maxes at `20`.

See `docs/ENFORCEMENT.md` for how these constraints are enforced in code, not just declared.
